responsibility: Declares the AST-to-token collection interface for the Rust frontend. It defines `CollectItem`, which can represent emitted tokens as well as formatting structure such as comments, newlines, and indentation, and the `TokenCollector` visitor class with helper routines for separator-joined lists, line/block emission, indentation management, and a large matrix of `visit` overloads covering the Rust AST, establishing the API used to recover tokenized source-like output from parsed AST nodes.
same_name_distinction: Defines the token-collection data model (`CollectItem`) and declares the `TokenCollector` visitor interface and helpers, whereas the same-stem `.cc` file supplies the per-node emission behavior that actually reconstructs token streams from AST nodes.
